# Smarter mob buffs

![Smarter mob buffs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bh679/dungeon-train-mc/main/.github/release-notes/images/smarter-mob-buffs.jpg)

Deep train potion buffs on train mobs have been reworked. The later stages of the game are more balanced. Rather than a flat potion effect for every mob, the effect is now a max, and they will get a random level between 1 and the current stage max. Additionally, mobs that turn up later get potion effects delayed (and babies get effects a little later too).

- **More variety:** the further you ride, the wider the spread. A buffed mob now rolls anywhere from level I up to that stretch's top level, so some are weaker than before and none are stronger.
- **Late arrivals catch up gradually:** mobs that only start showing up further down the train no longer get buffed the moment they appear. Their buffs begin later, counted from where they first show up.
- **Babies get a head start for you:** baby mobs get their buffs a little later than adults.

**Bug Fix ×2 · Mobs ×2 · Train ×1**

### 0.1399.0

**Mobs no longer get stuck in the train floor**

Mobs could appear standing inside a carriage floor, with their heads poking up through the deck as the train carried them along. An Enderman stuck there could even be angered by a glance from inside the carriage. Mobs no longer appear there, and any already stuck are moved out to the ground beside the train.

### 0.1398.0

**Mobs stay put in moving carriages**

Animals, villagers and monsters standing inside a carriage no longer slowly slide toward the back of the train. The further you travelled, the faster they slid, up to several blocks a minute on long runs. Now they stay where they stand.

Inside a dimensional carriage, the debug screen (F3) now puts the middle of the room at X 0, Z 0, so it reads as a place of its own rather than a spot along the track.

- Looking at a block in one shows the same disguised coordinates

**Two new death pages for lives you streamed**

If you wore the Live Eye at any point in a life, the death screen now tells the story of that broadcast: how long you were on air, what you shared, who took the Eye, and who stayed with you the most.

The photo page on the death screen now tallies the life you just lived: how many photos you took, how many of other players' photos you looked at, how many Tributes you paid and the emeralds they cost. The page now appears whenever there is something to count, even with no photos to show.

1.21.1.0.1318.0:
# New Mobs

![New Mobs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bh679/dungeon-train-mc/main/.github/release-notes/images/new-mobs.jpg)

New creatures have boarded the train. The first of many more to come.

Some carriages now hold mobs you’ve never met on the line before. A few turn up early, and some wait much further down the line, in the stranger stretches of the journey. Keep your eyes open and your sword ready.

## Other significant updates

- Your Live stream shares your advancements, photos and books in Live chat on Discord, Twitch and the website, with a switch for each on the Stream tab
- One Live Eye per player, and /streamer in Live chat shows who's on air
- Builders: test controls let you try a build at any stage, difficulty level or band, and Test the Carriage can bring your frozen mobs to life
- Builders: block variants can depend on their neighbours, and a dice button swaps the carriage around your contents
- Bug fixes

**New Feature ×8 · Editor ×7 · Bug Fix ×3 · Community ×3 · Train ×1 · Loot ×1 · Menus & UI ×1**

### 0.1318.0

**Test controls in the editor**

While you test a build from the editor, the template pane now gives you controls for the test itself. Try your build at any stage, difficulty level or band, and re-roll just your build or everything around it, all without changing the template.

- A test toolbar above the preview: Reload, Re-roll the rest, Re-roll this template and Re-roll everything
- Stage, Diff level and Band settings replace the data sheet while a test runs, and changing one re-stands the test on the same rolls
- Reload picks up templates you saved since the test started

**Back from a test returns you to the room you tested**

Leaving Test the Carriage now puts you back in the room you were testing, even when you started the test from another plot. Rooms inside a group come back with their group open, so you can carry straight on editing.

### 0.1317.0

**Reroll the carriage around your contents**

When you build carriage contents in the Train Editor, a new dice button above the preview swaps the carriage they stand in for another one that carries them on the train. Your unsaved changes stay put.

- New Reroll carriage button in the Train Editor's icon row for contents
- Only picks carriages that would really carry those contents, never the one already shown

**Block variants can depend on their neighbours**

In the editor, a block variant option can now say when it is allowed to appear: only next to certain blocks, or only when another locked group rolled certain blocks. Torches only on walls, glass only above planks, and matching sets that follow each other are now easy to build.

- New If button on each block variant option, with a choice of touching sides or a locked group
- Pick the sides with the same clicks as choosing bands: click to toggle one, shift-click to toggle the rest
- Add the blocks to look for from your hand, or switch on blocks from the chosen group

### 0.1316.0

**Taking over a Live Eye stream waits until you've seen the death**

When a Live Eye streamer dies, viewers are now offered the stream only after their TV has shown the death, instead of getting the offer before it happened on screen.

### 0.1315.0

**Block variant groups stay alive while a variant refers to them**

A group you add as an option in a block variant now keeps existing even after every cell of that group is gone from the template, so the option keeps working instead of going dead.

- A group added as a block variant option keeps its options after its last cell is removed or unlocked
- Middle-click a group row in the block variant menu to put that group in your hotbar
- Adding a group you copied from another template works even if this template has no cells in it

**Ask who's streaming**

Type /streamer in the Live chat, in game, on the website, on Discord or on Twitch, to see who's on air: their Minecraft, Twitch and Discord names, how long they've been live, how many times they've streamed before and their game language. Everyone in the chat sees the answer.

### 0.1314.0

**One Live Eye per player**

You can now carry only one Live Eye at a time, and that includes any in your ender chest or packed in a shulker box. Once you have one, chests show a TV where a Live Eye would be, a second one on the ground stays put for someone else, and any extra that slips into your inventory turns into a TV.

### 0.1313.0

**Unsupported plants no longer leave loot behind**

Moss, vines and other plants that need something to cling to used to pop off and drop an item when a carriage was built without a spot for them. They now quietly vanish instead, so there are no stray freebies lying on carriage floors or in the builder.

### 0.1312.0

**Your Live stream shares your advancements, photos and books**

While you stream with the Live Eye, the Live chat on Discord, Twitch and the website now shows when you earn an advancement, take a photo or sign a book. Photos show as the picture itself, on its paper, and books show their title and first lines. Nothing extra appears in your own game chat.

- Turn each one off on the Stream tab: Share advancements, Share photos, Share books
- Always off in Kid mode

**Test the Carriage can bring your mobs to life**

A new editor setting lets your frozen mobs wake up when you test a carriage, so you can see how a room plays with its creatures moving. Your build plots keep them still.

- New Test Mobs setting in the editor
- Works for every kind of template you can test
1.21.1.0.1311.0:
**New Feature ×2 · Bug Fix ×1 · Editor ×1 · Train ×1 · Loot ×1 · Advancements ×1 · Menus & UI ×1**

### 0.1311.0

**Dimensional carriage chests roll their own loot**

Chests built into a dimensional carriage now fill from the loot their builder set up, so each one you find can hold something different instead of the same items every time. In the editor, Reseed on Test the Carriage now re-rolls those chests too.

- Builders: Reseed (Cmd/Ctrl+R) shows a fresh roll of every chest that has a loot list

**Pick your difficulty for the next run, or restart on it now**

Changing difficulty mid-run now asks what you want: keep this run going and start the next one on the new difficulty, or abandon this run and board a fresh train on it straight away. Dungeon Train remembers your choice for every new world, and the Options menu has a Difficulty setting of its own.

- Save a difficulty change for your next run, or restart on it now.
- Your chosen difficulty carries over to every new world.
- Advancement stats are now kept for each difficulty.

**Something for the road**

Some travellers may find the train has left them a small kindness.

### 0.1310.0

**Signed books in loot tables keep their words**

Adding a signed book to a chest's loot in the editor now puts that exact book in the chest — its title, author and every page — instead of a blank written book.

- The editor's loot list shows the book's title next to it

**Every editor number works the same way**

Every number you can change in the Train Editor now works the same way: click to raise it, shift-click or right-click to lower it, and Cmd-click (Ctrl-click on Windows and Linux) to type an exact value. That now includes a mob's min and max level, container fill and drop chances, room sizes, exit spacing and more. Rows that had separate − and + buttons are now a single number, and a typed max level or max fill left empty goes back to "all".

- Cmd-click any editor number to type it — including a mob's min and max level
- Right-click lowers a number, the same as shift-click
- Leave a max level or max fill empty to set it back to "all"

**Switch a TV on or off with anything in hand**

Right-click a placed TV to turn it on or off, whatever you're holding — your item isn't used or placed. Sneak to place a block against it instead.

**Bed explosion deaths show a proper death message**

Dying to a bed explosion now shows a real death message on the death screen instead of a raw game id. Fall deaths now read like the chat message too, so you can see how you fell or who knocked you off.

- Bed explosion: "You were killed by [Intentional Game Design]"
- Falls: "You fell from a high place", "You were doomed to fall by Zombie"

**New versions are announced in the Live chat**

When a new version of Dungeon Train comes out, the Live chat now says so: on the website's live page, in the Discord live room, and in Twitch chat while someone is streaming. If you're in game you still see the usual update notice, just once.

**Advancement pop-ups on your Live stream**

Viewers now see your advancement pop-ups even when you stream with chat hidden, and the pop-ups sit on top of your name at the top of the stream instead of under it.

- Pop-ups reach the stream with Stream chat off, Kid mode included
- Pop-ups show over your name on the stream; turn this off with "Pop-ups over your name" on the Stream or Performance tab

# Pass the Live Eye

![Pass the Live Eye](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bh679/dungeon-train-mc/main/.github/release-notes/images/pass-the-live-eye.gif)

Dungeon Train TV keeps going. The Live Eye now passes from player to player instead of just cutting off.

Die live and your stream carries on. Your viewers watch the death screens with you while your last few seconds loop behind them, and anyone watching on a TV can take the Live Eye and go live in your place. First click wins.

Put on a Live Eye while someone else is streaming and you're asked whether to take over. Early in their stream the viewers vote in chat; after that it's your call. And if a newcomer tunes in on a TV while you're live, you can gift them yours.

- Lose a takeover, or choose to stay a viewer, and your Live Eye turns into a TV instead of burning

- New streamers get their first minutes to themselves, and the viewers decide whether someone can take over early
- Vote Yes or No in the Live chat, wherever you're watching; votes stay hidden until the result
- A countdown shows over the live feed while the vote runs
- Losing the stream, or choosing to stay a viewer, turns your Live Eye into a TV instead of burning it

1.21.1.0.1285.0:
**Bug Fix ×6 · Community ×6 · Performance ×2**

### 0.1285.0

**Live Feed TVs play only safe streams, and recover on their own**

TVs showing the Live Feed now only play a stream made of its own video pieces from Dungeon Train's storage. A stream that tries to point elsewhere shows static instead. A feed that freezes now restarts by itself even when no TV is in view, a stream nobody is watching stops downloading, and each frame of the picture is far cheaper to prepare.

- A tampered or unsafe stream shows static instead of playing
- A frozen feed restarts on its own, even when you're not looking at a TV
- Watching the feed costs much less per frame, most noticeable at the highest TV resolution

**Smoother Live Eye streaming**

Putting on the Live Eye no longer makes the game hitch while the stream starts, and streaming costs less frame time: the on-screen viewfinder and the pinned live box are much cheaper to draw. Logging back in while wearing the Live Eye starts one stream instead of two, a hand-edited odd video width no longer stops the stream, and ending a stream no longer leaks memory.

**Quitting while streaming no longer hangs**

Live Eye: quitting the game mid-stream on a bad connection now closes within a few seconds instead of hanging for up to a minute and a half, and the end of the stream reaches viewers more reliably when you leave a world or quit straight after. When the stream server can't be reached, the game also waits longer between retries instead of trying twice a second.

### 0.1284.0

**Live Feed no longer crashes on a shaky connection**

Live Feed: a shaky connection on the streamer's side no longer makes the stream crash for viewers — a lost 10-second piece is skipped instead of taking the whole stream down.

**Live Eye only broadcasts while worn**

The Live Eye now only broadcasts while you are wearing it, and menus you open — the chat box included — are never shown to viewers. Viewers see your world and HUD, plus the chat lines on your screen (whispers included) when Show chat to viewers is on.

**Live Chat keeps working after a relay restart**

In-game Live Chat no longer goes quiet for the rest of a stream when the relay is restarted mid-stream — the chat picks up again on its own.
